events.title: Alan Shearer scores a hat-trick in 블랙번 로버스's 4–2 home win against 웨스트햄 유나이티드, and 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a 1–1 home draw by 첼시, meaning that 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 could be on the verge of a seven-point lead at the top of the Premier League.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are held to a 3–3 draw at 윔블던, limiting their lead at the top of the table to five points. 선덜랜드 overtake 밀월 at the top of Division One with a 1–0 win over 크리스털 팰리스 at Roker Park.

Coventry striker Dion Dublin finds himself in the unusual situation of scoring a hat-trick for the losing side when the Sky Blues lose 4–3 to 셰필드 웬즈데이 at Hillsborough in the Premier League. Coventry are bottom of the table, having won just one of their first 16 Premier League games.
Mark McGhee leaves Division One promotion challengers 레스터 시티 after a year in charge to become manager of 울버햄프턴 원더러스.
Dutch club NEC 네이메헌 fires Cees van Kooten and appoints Wim Koevermans .

Defending Premier League champions 블랙번 로버스 are beaten 5–0 at Coventry, and in Division One 선덜랜드 beat Millall 6–0 to maintain their lead of the table with a 6–0 win at Roker Park . 맨체스터 유나이티드 drop two points when they are held to a 2–2 draw at home to 셰필드 웬즈데이 in the Premier League, but leaders 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 drop all three points when they lose 1–0 at 첼시, meaning that their lead is cut to four points when a victory would have put them seven points ahead.

Having fallen into the bottom three yesterday when other results went against them, 울버햄프턴 원더러스 climb three places in Division One when a 3–2 win at Luton ends their six-match winless run in the league.

Dave Bassett , the fifth-longest-serving manager in the English league, resigns as manager of Division One's 셰필드 유나이티드 after nearly eight years in charge. 월솔 beat 토키 유나이티드 8–4 in the FA Cup second-round replay at Bescot Stadium which followed a 1–1 draw in the first match at Plainmoor 10 days ago.
The Lebanese national team beat Slovakia national football team 2 – 1 in a friendly match in Beirut .
Former 에버턴 manager Howard Kendall is named the new manager of 셰필드 유나이티드.
The Netherlands national team qualifies for Euro 1996 by defeating the Republic of Ireland (2–0) in a play-off at Anfield Road , 리버풀 . Both goals are scored by Patrick Kluivert .
유럽사법재판소가 보스만 사건에 대한 판결을 내렸다. 프로 선수의 이동과 계약 만료 후 이적 규정, 국적에 따른 제한이 쟁점이 된 판결이다.
QPR sell misfits defender Ned Zelic to 프랑크푸르트 for £1million.

The European Court of Justice makes the Bosman ruling , which means all footballers not under contract are free to move clubs without any economic compensation to their former club. A secondary result of the ruling means the abolition of the foreign player quotas, at least as they affect nationals of European Union member states.
Korean club Suwon Samsung Bluewings is officially founded.

블랙번 로버스 left back Graeme Le Saux fractures his ankle in a 1–0 home win against 미들즈브러 in the FA Premier League, an injury which is set to rule him out of action until next season. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 go seven points ahead in the Premier League with a 1–0 victory over 에버턴, and 애스턴 빌라 striker Savo Milosevic scores a hat-trick in Villa's 4–1 home win against 코번트리 시티. Yorkshire rivals 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 리즈 유나이티드 clash at Hillsborough, with the hosts winning a thrilling match 6–2. Bolton remain bottom of the table after losing 2–1 at QPR, who climb out of the bottom three.

맨체스터 유나이티드 remain seven points behind 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 after losing 2–0 at 리버풀, with Robbie Fowler scoring both of 리버풀's goals. A series of saves from 페테르 슈마이켈 prevent United from suffering a considerably heavier defeat.

마틴 오닐 resigns after six months as 노리치 시티 manager to take over at 레스터 시티, and Division One bottom club 루턴 타운 replace Terry Westley with 브래드퍼드 시티's Lennie Lawrence . England World Cup winner 잭 찰턴 resigns after nearly 10 years as manager of the Republic of Ireland national football team , following the nation's failure to qualify for Euro 96.
볼턴 원더러스, the bottom club in the Premier League, pay a club-record £1.2 million for 셰필드 유나이티드 striker Nathan Blake .

코번트리 시티 defeat 에버턴 2–1 at home. Robbie Fowler scores a hat-trick for 리버풀 at home against 아스널 for the second season running in a 3–1 win. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 extend their lead to 10 points with a 3–1 win over 노팅엄 포리스트. 미들즈브러 go fifth with a 4–2 home win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 더비 카운티 go top of Division One with a 2–1 home win over 선덜랜드, who fall into second place.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 remain 10 points ahead as their nearest rivals, 맨체스터 유나이티드, lose 3–1 at 리즈 유나이티드. The top two will meet in three days time for a showdown at Old Trafford.
A Boxing Day London derby at Highbury sees 아스널 beat QPR 3–0 to send the hosts fifth in the Premier League and leave the hosts fourth from bottom.

맨체스터 유나이티드 cut the lead in the FA Premier League to seven points with a 2–0 home win against 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 with goals from Andy Cole and Roy Keane . The only other league action of the day sees Leeds keep their bid for a second successive UEFA Cup campaign on track with a 2–0 win over Bolton at Burnden Park .
맨체스터 유나이티드 reduce 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's lead to four points with a 2–1 win against struggling 퀸스 파크 레인저스. Alan Shearer scores his 100th goal for 블랙번 로버스 in a 2–1 home win against 토트넘 홋스퍼.
